title: Anti-Ragging Policy
description: Defines ragging as a punishable offense and outlines the institute's zero-tolerance stance. Details the complaint mechanism, investigation process, and consequences in line with regulatory requirements.

title: Academic Integrity & Anti-Plagiarism Policy
description: Sets out the standards of academic honesty expected from students and researchers. Describes the definition of plagiarism, acceptable citation practices, detection tools used, and the disciplinary process for violations.

title: Student Data Privacy Policy
description: Safeguards students' personal and academic information from unauthorized access or misuse. Ensures all student data is collected, stored, and processed responsibly in compliance with data protection regulations.

title: Prevention of Sexual Harassment (POSH) Policy
description: Establishes a safe and inclusive campus environment by defining prohibited conduct, providing a clear complaints mechanism, and ensuring timely redressal of sexual harassment complaints.

title: Research Ethics Guidelines
description: Provides guidelines for conducting ethical research involving human participants, data collection, intellectual property rights, and publication standards. Ensures research integrity across all academic departments.
